post.description: Exchanges the admin password for an HttpOnly session cookie.
Revokes the current session and clears the cookie.

get.description: Reports whether auth is enabled and whether the caller is authenticated.
Lists API token metadata (never the secrets). Requires a session or the admin password.

post.description: Mints a long-lived bearer token (returned only once). Requires a session or the admin password (not another token).

delete.description: Revokes an API token by id. Requires a session or the admin password.

post.description: Empties a stopped capture's pcap so a later export starts fresh.

get.description: Re-dissects a single packet from a capture's pcap into a full JSON protocol tree (Wireshark's own dissection via tshark -T json).

Streams the pcap a capture run wrote, as a file download. Without `frames` it returns the whole capture; with `frames` (a comma list of numbers/ranges, e.g. 1-5,9,12-20) it returns only those packets (used to export the current display filter).

Injects an ephemeral tshark container into the pod (sharing its network namespace) and streams a live capture of one interface. Control frames are JSON ({type:"meta"|"status"|"error"}); every other text frame is one packet row as tab-separated Wireshark columns (No, Time, Source, Destination, Protocol, Length, Info). Closing the socket stops the capture. Optional `filter` is a BPF capture filter; optional `container` reuses an existing capture container on reconnect.

Returns the full kubectl-derivable view of a single node: pod CIDR, addresses, OS info, kubelet/runtime versions, capacity vs allocatable, conditions, taints, labels and annotations. Live usage is included when metrics-server is reachable.
Returns connection status and node info for the Kubernetes cluster.
Returns all registered KubeNDT drivers (e.g. linux-switch, ovs-switch, frr-router).

delete.description: Deletes all persisted driver operations across all pods in the namespace.
delete.summary: Delete persisted driver history for a namespace

delete.description: Deletes all persisted driver operations for one resolved pod in a namespace (supports base name and indexed pod name).
delete.summary: Delete persisted driver history for one pod

delete.description: Removes a single persisted driver operation from history using its unique operation ID.
delete.summary: Delete one persisted driver operation by ID

get.description: Returns all persisted driver operations for the namespace across all pods in execution order (oldest first). Each entry includes action payload, execution timestamp, pod name, and equivalent shell commands reconstructed from current driver capabilities when available.
get.summary: List persisted driver history by namespace

get.description: Returns persisted driver operations for a resolved pod in a namespace (supports base name and indexed pod name). Entries are ordered by insertion time and include action payload, timestamp, and reconstructed equivalent shell commands.
get.summary: List persisted driver history by pod

get.description: Returns the full info (type, executor, capabilities and interface-name constraints) for one registered driver. Same per-item shape used by `GET /drivers/`.
Downloads all files for a namespace as an archive. The format is chosen with the `format` query param.

post.description: Creates a new directory inside namespace file storage.
Imports a .zip or .tar.gz archive into namespace file storage.
Renames or moves a file within namespace storage.

get.description: Lists files and directories in the namespace's file storage.

delete.description: Permanently removes every file and folder inside the namespace file-manager directory, then recreates the empty directory.

post.description: Uploads a file to the namespace's file storage (multipart/form-data).

get.description: Returns the raw content of a file stored for the namespace.

put.description: Overwrites the content of an existing file.

delete.description: Deletes a file from namespace storage.

get.description: Returns basic service/process health and build metadata.
Returns information about the currently loaded kubeconfig (contexts, current context, server URLs).

post.description: Loads kubeconfig from an uploaded file.

get.description: Returns all Kubernetes namespaces labelled kubendt/enabled=true.

post.description: Creates a new Kubernetes namespace and labels it for KubeNDT.

409.description: Namespace name already exists (empty or with resources)

get.description: Returns IP, MAC, and NAT configuration for every pod in the namespace.
get.summary: Get interfaces for all pods in a namespace

get.description: Returns real-time CPU (millicores) and memory (bytes/MiB) usage for every pod in a namespace, both per-pod and aggregated over the namespace, via the Kubernetes metrics-server API. Returns HTTP 503 with {"available": false} when metrics-server is not installed or not yet ready.
Returns the active operation lock (deploy/modify/clear) for the namespace, or null when idle. Cheap DB read; polled by the UI to reflect a running operation after a reload or navigation.
Returns an aggregated operational summary of the namespace: topology status, node/pod counts, type and driver distribution, persisted operation stats, and active namespace lock (if any).

delete.description: Deletes a KubeNDT namespace and all resources inside it.
Deletes all topology resources in a namespace without deleting the namespace itself.

post.description: Applies driver-based configuration actions (routes, bridges, NAT, TC, etc.) to pods concurrently. Each action can include options: {"persist_history": false, "capture_output": true}. The response includes a sequential_equivalent time (sum of per-pod durations) and a speedup factor vs the concurrent wall time.

Deploys a full network topology (nodes + links) into a namespace. In links, use the reserved name "external" for either node or peerNode to create a host uplink (external network connection). Both ends of a link cannot be "external" simultaneously.

parameters.description: Deploy even if the Meshnet CNI is not detected. Without it a missing Meshnet returns 412 and nothing is deployed.
parameters.name: force

get.description: Returns the current network topology deployed in a namespace.

post.description: Adds or removes nodes/links from an existing topology. Any change (add, delete or scale) returns 412 when the Meshnet CNI is not detected, since it restarts or creates pods that need rewiring. Bypass with force=true. Only clearing a topology is exempt.

parameters.description: Apply the change even if the Meshnet CNI is not detected.
parameters.name: force

get.description: Returns the saved visual positions for nodes in a namespace.

post.description: Persists visual positions of nodes in the topology graph.

parameters.description: Map of node name to {x, y} position
parameters.name: body

get.description:
Returns interface list (name, MAC, IPv4) for a single pod. By
default the result is scoped to the interfaces declared in the
pod's topology (its link endpoints), excluding the reserved CNI
management interface, loopback and kernel pseudo-interfaces. Use
scope=all for the full set including the management interface.

Returns real-time CPU (millicores) and memory (bytes/MiB) usage for a single pod via the Kubernetes metrics-server API. Returns HTTP 503 with {"available": false} when metrics-server is not installed or not yet ready.

patch.description:
Restarts a pod by deleting it (the StatefulSet controller recreates it),
waits for it to reach Running state, then replays all persisted driver
operations from its history. The response includes a took_time breakdown
separating pod_restart (time until Running) from replay (re-execution of
persisted actions).

get.description: Returns Traffic Control qdisc information for a pod interface.
Lists all KubeNDT-managed pods (StatefulSets) in a namespace.
Returns readiness state for backend dependencies such as database and Kubernetes clients.
Opens a WebSocket connection providing an interactive shell inside a pod. Query parameter `mode` controls shell type: `auto` (default), `sh`, or `serial`.

Runs a traceroute (or mtr when metrics=1) from a source pod toward an IP or hostname and returns the whole result as one JSON document, each hop resolved to a topology node. Blocks until the probe finishes. The source node must be L3-capable. The probe runs in a shared debug container in the pod, so the pod image needs no traceroute of its own. A live animated version streams the same hops over WebSocket at /trace/ws/{namespace}/{podName}.

parameters.description: Source pod (base name or indexed pod name); must be L3-capable
parameters.name: podName

parameters.description: Probe method: icmp (default), udp or tcp
parameters.name: method

parameters.description: Set 1 for metrics mode (mtr latency/loss) instead of a plain traceroute
parameters.name: metrics

parameters.description: mtr probe rounds (metrics mode only; default 5)
parameters.name: cycles

get.description: Returns service name and build metadata.

capture_output.description: CaptureOutput controls whether command output is returned in the response.

persist_history.description: PersistHistory controls whether the action is persisted in driver history.

avg_cpu_percentage.description:
Cluster-wide weighted averages computed as sum(usage)/sum(capacity)
across nodes that report metrics. Zero when metrics-server is
unavailable or no node reports metrics.

expires_in_days.description: Days until the token expires; 0 or omitted means it never expires.

example: ip route add 10.10.0.0/16 via 10.0.0.1 dev net1

context_cluster_ids.description:
ContextClusterIDs maps each context name to its cluster's canonical ID
(the kube-system namespace UID). Contexts whose cluster is currently
unreachable are omitted.

peerNode.description: use "external" as reserved name for host uplinks

error.example: Meshnet CNI not detected in the cluster. Topology links would not be wired. Install Meshnet, or retry with force=true to deploy anyway.

missing.description: file is mounted but no longer present in the namespace file manager

has_topology.description:
HasTopology reflects whether a KubeNDT topology is currently deployed
in this namespace (StatefulSets/Topology CRDs registered). Updated by
deploy / modify / clear flows and cheap to read (DB lookup).

error.example: Namespace 'prueba' already has an operation in progress

scale.description:
Scale changes the replica count of existing nodes. Each entry takes
the absolute number of replicas the node should end with. Replicas
must be >= 1 (to remove a node entirely use delete.nodes).

l3capable.description:
L3Capable reports whether the node can originate a traceroute. It gates the
"Traceroute from here" menu item and is true only for L3-capable drivers.

error.example: metrics-server not available or not installed

kind.description:
Kind is "l3" for a resolved node, "external" for a real IP outside the
topology, or "timeout" for no reply.

segment.description:
Segment is "link" for a topology path (maybe through switches) or "tunnel"
for an overlay jump like GTP-U.

unreachable.description:
Unreachable holds the ICMP flag ("!N", "!H") when a router dropped the
probe, empty otherwise.

detail.example: File "web-server/index.html" not found in namespace file manager. Mount skipped, the pod will start without it.
